verdict.rationale: Highnote documents an official server-side `@highnote-oss/nodejs-sdk` that wraps its API in typed, resource-oriented methods, plus several official client-side SDKs (Card Viewer, Checkout, Secure Inputs, Document Upload). However, the only general API SDK is Node.js and is explicitly in beta, and the UI SDKs cover narrow PCI-scoped embeds rather than the full API, so coverage is incomplete. Missing for 10: a stable (non-beta) general API SDK, SDKs for languages beyond Node.js, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: the official `@highnote-oss/nodejs-sdk` (currently in beta) wraps the Highnote API in typed, resource-oriented methods — no GraphQL required.
Build faster with GraphQL API, interactive code explorer, PCI-compliant SDKs, and real-time web hooks designed for modern development.
The Highnote Card Viewer SDK lets you embed sensitive card data into your UI using iframes.
The Highnote Secure Inputs SDK can be used to tokenize payment method details so you can process payments in your application or website.
